neighbours.label: keeping something in its physical position (hold it in place, so it doesn't slip, set_position), as against idioms with 'place' that are not about position (take place, in place of)
fire: A strap behind your head keeps the goggles from slipping.
Use two pins to hold the hem in place while you sew.
Tiny hooks hold the lens firmly in place inside the frame.
Put a rubber mat under the rug so it doesn't slip on the tiles.
The surgeon used screws to keep the broken bone in place.
A dab of glue will hold the tile in place until it sets.
Wear a clip so the scarf stays in place on windy days.
Sticky pads stop the phone from slipping off the dashboard.
quiet: The swimming race will take place in the new pool on Sunday.
Use oat milk in place of cream in the soup.
Tiny shops line the old square in the centre of town.
In the first place, we never agreed to pay for the rug.
The surgeon took a short break before the next operation.
The wedding took place in a small chapel by the lake.
Wear a scarf on windy days to stay warm.
The phone rang twice before she picked it up.
